name: unmixLinear
code: double dx = (factor.dx - min.dx) / (max.value - min.value) - ((factor.value - min.value) * (max.dx - min.dx)) / (max.value - min.value) ^ 2
double dy = (factor.dy - min.dy) / (max.value - min.value) - ((factor.value - min.value) * (max.dy - min.dy)) / (max.value - min.value) ^ 2
